_comment: One file = provider + corpus config. Copy to config.json next to your documents and adjust. Provider keys: model/type/url/api_key/max_tokens/capabilities/thinking_effort/env/timeout. Corpus keys: dirs (input dirs, relative to THIS file), corpus_dir, index_dir. Engine tuning: mode/rrf_k/bm25_k/dense_k/final_k/path_boost/bm25_aux/embed_model/rerank/compile_workers/accept_legacy_models/llm_timeout/provider_wait_budget_s. Compile unit: checkpoint_every/progress_every default to 1 page (one page = one LLM session; the manifest is flushed after every page). Extra provider shards for multi-provider sharding go in 'providers'. With no --config flag, ./config.json in the CWD is used.
_comment_compile_unit: The compile unit is ONE PAGE: one LLM session per page, one progress line per page, and the incremental manifest flush per page (a kill loses at most the pages in flight). Raise these only to batch manifest writes on very large builds; 0 disables the progress line / the per-page flush.
